flags.message: Forward-mode retrieval of the live supremecourt.gov docket for 26A382 showed an amicus brief (Becket Fund) filed 2026-09-25, one day past the provisioned cutoff of 2026-09-24. The frozen context carries amicus_briefs=0, so the amicus-increment claim is effectively already resolved true; I set it at 0.96 on that basis. No disposition had been entered as of retrieval.
